evidence: Extends the libbitcoinkernel C API and C++ wrapper in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h and src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp with prune lock and target pruning functions.
rationale: Exposes prune lock management and target-based pruning needed for asynchronous block reading by external library consumers. As noted in commit 37e40a00e9, applications reading blocks after connection require locks to prevent the node from deleting them before processing completes.
